canonical_facts: Snow White is a runaway girl; the apparent Queen is her searching mother.
The apparent dwarfs are traffickers who imprison the girl, steal her valuables, and sell her to an outsider.

host_examples.rationale: The girl is held captive and cannot answer her mother.
